newsitem.title: USA: Plum Street sets New York natgas sales.
newsitem.headline: Plum Street sets New York natgas sales.

text.p: Plum Street Energy Marketing said Monday it has signed two one-year contracts to provide natural gas supply.

The first contract is with Rochester, N.Y.-based Highland Hospital and the second is with Buffalo Commercial Property Owners Association, which is comprised of 11 landmark buildings in downtown Buffalo.

For Highland Hospital, the Niagara Mohawk Power Corp subsidiary said, it will provide up to 95 million Btu a year to its facilities. The agreement with the Buffalo Commercial Property Owners Association's calls for Plum Street to provide up to 255,750,000 Btu a year to the Buffalo buildings.
